versions.content: Figure 7.15: - Communication phases Client [SWS_Sd_00761] Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00162, SRS_Eth_00014 ⌈A client shall check the socket connection by calling SoAd_IsConnectionReady() to ensure that the connection is ready for communication (i.e., ARP has finished, TCP connection established, security association established etc. before subscribing or calling a method ). • If the function returns TCPIP_E_OK, then the connection is ready for communi- cation, thus the client can send a SubscribeEventgroup entry or call methods. • If the function returns TCPIP_E_PENDING, then SD shall repeat the call in next Sd_MainFunction() in accordance with the respective OfferService entry . • For all other values SD shall apply [SWS_Sd_00785]. ⌋
